title: Keto Rajma Curry
description: A flavorful and spicy curry made with kidney beans in an Indian-inspired tomato sauce. This recipe is suitable for a keto diet.

ingredients.name: Kidney beans
ingredients.notes: Choose a low-carb variety or cook according to package instructions.

ingredients.name: Tomato sauce
ingredients.notes: Make sure to choose a sugar-free and low-carb tomato sauce.

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee or coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and sauté until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the garam masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, and cayenne pepper (if using). Mix well and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the kidney beans and cook for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot over a bed of warm, crisp greens or with a side of cauliflower rice.
